output.subject: Payment timing for PO-2302
output.body:
Hello Jaipur Textiles team,

Thank you for your continued partnership. We would like to ask whether you could allow 10 more days on PO-2302 (₹2,000,000 in total) for the balance that falls due Dec 15. It would help us manage our cash through the year-end period, and we would be grateful for any flexibility you can offer.

Please let me know what is possible.

Thank you,
Cascade Trade Co.
